title: B.Tech fee structure overview
content: Bennett University's current fee-structure page lists different tuition fees by B.Tech program. B.Tech Computer Science Engineering is listed at ₹3,80,000 for Year 1, ₹3,90,000 for Year 2, ₹4,00,000 for Year 3 and ₹4,00,000 for Year 4, with total tuition fees of ₹15,70,000. B.Tech Electronics and Communications Engineering is listed at ₹3,60,000, ₹3,70,000, ₹3,80,000 and ₹3,80,000 by year, totaling ₹14,90,000. B.Tech Mechanical Engineering and B.Tech Engineering Physics are also listed with ₹3,60,000, ₹3,70,000, ₹3,80,000 and ₹3,80,000 by year, totaling ₹14,90,000. Fees are subject to revision with the new academic year as per Bennett University policy.
